learning_path:
**Learning Path for Cybersecurity, Network Defense, and Ethical Hacking**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU3345 | The Complete Ethical Hacking Bootcamp: Beginner To Advanced Specialization | Coursera | Foundational course covering the basics of ethical hacking, network security, and penetration testing. |
| 2 | COU2279 | Cybersecurity Attack and Defense Fundamentals Specialization | Coursera | Builds on the previous course, focusing on attack and defense strategies, digital forensics, and network defense. |
| 3 | COU4667 | Introduction to Cybersecurity Foundations | Coursera | Introduces the learner to the fundamentals of cybersecurity, including networking, cloud computing, and security principles. |
| 4 | COU1462 | Ethical Hacking Fundamentals | Coursera | Expands on the previous course, covering intermediate-level topics in penetration testing, footprinting, and cyber security assessment. |
| 5 | COU5344 | Cybersecurity Fundamentals Specialization | Coursera | Focuses on the fundamentals of computer security incident management, security domains, and career development in cybersecurity. |
| 6 | COU6211 | Cybersecurity and Its Ten Domains | Coursera | Introduces the learner to the ten domains of cybersecurity, including cryptography, information security, and cyber-security regulation. |
| 7 | COU2156 | IT Fundamentals for Cybersecurity Specialization | Coursera | Covers the basics of networking, database vulnerabilities, operating system security, and cyber attacks. |
| 8 | COU5555 | Foundations of Cybersecurity | Coursera | Expands on the previous course, covering the NIST cybersecurity framework, historical attacks, and ethics in cybersecurity. |
| 9 | COU3811 | Penetration Testing, Threat Hunting, and Cryptography | Coursera | Focuses on advanced topics in penetration testing, threat hunting, and cryptography, building on the previous courses. |
| 10 | COU1726 | Introduction to Cybersecurity Essentials | Coursera | Introduces the learner to the essentials of cybersecurity, including cryptography, cyberattacks, and information security. |

This learning path covers the full duration of 10 periods, with at least one course per period. The path starts with foundational courses in ethical hacking and cybersecurity fundamentals, then progresses to intermediate-level topics in penetration testing, threat hunting, and cryptography. The final course introduces the learner to advanced topics in penetration testing, threat hunting, and cryptography. The path is designed to build on prior knowledge and skills, with each new course introducing new ideas and concepts gradually to avoid overwhelming the learner. The path also incorporates hands-on activities, simulations, and real-world scenarios to make the learning experience engaging and relevant.
expanded_query: This query is for a course that covers cybersecurity, network defense, and ethical hacking at a beginner level, with a duration of 3-6 months.

**Learning Path Explanation**

This learning path starts with a foundational course in data engineering, introducing the learner to the concepts and tools of the field. The next course builds on this foundation, introducing data engineering concepts and tools, including database (DBMS) and SQL. The third course focuses on data pipelines, ETL, and Spark, building on the previous courses and introducing hands-on experience with tools and technologies. The fourth course advances to an intermediate level, covering data management, dataops, data warehousing, and data modeling, with a focus on practical application and problem-solving. The fifth course focuses on data engineering with Hadoop, building on the previous courses and introducing hands-on experience with big data and data pipelines. The sixth course advances to an advanced level, covering data analysis, data visualization, and data cleansing, with a focus on practical application and problem-solving. The final course is a capstone project, where the learner applies all the skills and knowledge gained throughout the learning path to a real-world data engineering project.

learning_path:
**Learning Path for Confident Public Speaker and Presenter**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU4650 | Dynamic Public Speaking Specialization | Coursera | Foundational course to build confidence in public speaking |
| 2 | COU278 | Introduction to Public Speaking | Coursera | Develops essential skills in presentation and speech |
| 3 | COU2068 | Presentations: Speaking so that People Listen | Coursera | Focuses on effective communication and presentation structure |
| 4 | COU2652 | Speak English Professionally: In Person, Online & On the Phone | Coursera | Enhances English speaking skills for professional settings |
| 5 | COU6415 | Communicating with the Public | Coursera | Develops skills in writing, interviewing, and public speaking |
| 6 | COU278 | Introduction to Public Speaking | Coursera | Revisits and reinforces foundational skills in public speaking |
| 7 | COU2068 | Presentations: Speaking so that People Listen | Coursera | Focuses on effective communication and presentation structure |
| 8 | COU3994 | Successful Presentation | Coursera | Develops skills in presentation, public speaking, and communication |
| 9 | COU1484 | Speaking to inform: Discussing complex ideas with clear explanations and dynamic slides | Coursera | Enhances skills in presenting complex ideas and data |
| 10 | COU2068 | Presentations: Speaking so that People Listen | Coursera | Revisits and reinforces skills in effective communication and presentation structure |
| 11 | COU617 | Communication For Everyone Specialization | Coursera | Develops soft skills and professional skills for effective communication |
| 12 | COU1484 | Speaking to inform: Discussing complex ideas with clear explanations and dynamic slides | Coursera | Enhances skills in presenting complex ideas and data |
| 13 | COU6511 | Advanced Speaking and Listening Project | Coursera | Develops advanced skills in academic speaking and presentation |
| 14 | COU1484 | Speaking to inform: Discussing complex ideas with clear explanations and dynamic slides | Coursera | Revisits and reinforces skills in presenting complex ideas and data |
| 15 | COU1484 | Speaking to inform: Discussing complex ideas with clear explanations and dynamic slides | Coursera | Final course to solidify skills in public speaking and presentation |

**How the path fits together**

This learning path is designed to help learners become confident public speakers and presenters. It starts with foundational courses in public speaking and presentation, such as Dynamic Public Speaking Specialization and Introduction to Public Speaking. As learners progress, they develop skills in effective communication, presentation structure, and English speaking. The path also includes courses that focus on specific skills, such as presenting complex ideas and data, and developing soft skills and professional skills for effective communication. The final courses in the path reinforce and solidify the learners' skills in public speaking and presentation.

learning_path:
**Learning Path for Adult Learner**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU4268 | Introduction to Mechanics Specialization | Coursera | Foundational course to establish a strong understanding of mechanics and physics |
| 2 | EDX504 | Pre-University Physics | edX | Builds on the foundational course, covering mechanics, electricity, and magnetism |
| 3 | COU1125 | Physics 101 - Forces and Kinematics | Coursera | Develops problem-solving skills in mechanics and physics |
| 4 | EDX83 | Is this Physics or Magic? Learning Physics through Minds-on Science Demonstration | edX | Applies physics concepts to real-world phenomena |
| 5 | COU6139 | Modern Robotics, Course 3: Robot Dynamics | Coursera | Introduces robotics and dynamics, building on previous courses |
| 6 | EDX1500 | A-level Mathematics for Year 13 - Course 2: General Motion, Moments and Equilibrium, The Normal Distribution, Vectors, Differentiation Methods, ... | edX | Develops mathematical skills in kinematics, vectors, and differentiation |
| 7 | COU6020 | Physics 101 - Energy and Momentum | Coursera | Applies energy and momentum concepts to real-world problems |
| 8 | EDX1163 | On-Ramp to AP* Physics C: Mechanics | edX | Prepares for AP Physics C, covering kinematics, forces, and energy |
| 9 | COU3174 | Introduction to Electricity and Magnetism Specialization | Coursera | Introduces electricity and magnetism, building on previous courses |
| 10 | EDX1775 | Mechanics, Part 1 | edX | Develops problem-solving skills in mechanics and physics, with a focus on kinematics and work-energy |
| 11 | COU2618 | Modern Robotics: Mechanics, Planning, and Control Specialization | Coursera | Applies robotics and control concepts to real-world problems |
| 12 | EDX1045 | AP* Physics 1: Challenging Concepts | edX | Prepares for AP Physics 1, covering challenging concepts in mechanics and physics |

**Path Explanation**

This learning path is designed to help an adult learner return to study physics and mechanics. The path starts with a foundational course in mechanics and physics (COU4268), followed by a course that builds on this foundation, covering mechanics, electricity, and magnetism (EDX504). The learner then develops problem-solving skills in mechanics and physics (COU1125) and applies physics concepts to real-world phenomena (EDX83). The path continues with courses that introduce robotics and dynamics (COU6139), develop mathematical skills in kinematics, vectors, and differentiation (EDX1500), and apply energy and momentum concepts to real-world problems (COU6020). The learner then prepares for AP Physics C, covering kinematics, forces, and energy (EDX1163), and develops problem-solving skills in mechanics and physics, with a focus on kinematics and work-energy (EDX1775). Finally, the path concludes with courses that apply robotics and control concepts to real-world problems (COU2618) and prepare the learner for AP Physics 1, covering challenging concepts in mechanics and physics (EDX1045).
